--- tom joins room ---
{"room_id":"!fecb8580371b5f46:localhost"}
[join http: 200]
--- tom reads room (should see alex's message) ---
[read http: 200]
"body":"Hello from Nebu install verification"
--- senders in room ---

"sender":"@tom:localhost"

observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
TOM_TOKEN=$(cat tom_token.txt)
ROOM_ID=$(cat alex_room.txt)
ENC=$(printf '%s' "$ROOM_ID" | sed 's/!/%21/g; s/:/%3A/g')
echo "--- tom joins room ---"
curl -s -X POST --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOM_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/join/$ENC" -w "\n[join http: %{http_code}]\n"
echo "--- tom reads room (should see alex's message) ---"
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOM_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ENC/messages?dir=b&limit=5" -o tom_msgs.json -w "[read http: %{http_code}]\n"
grep -o '"body":"[^"]*"' tom_msgs.json
echo "--- senders in room ---"
grep -o '"sender":"@[^"]*"' tom_msgs.json | sort -u
